lines.text: Plumbers make about $31 an hour. Some bill $200.
lines.say: Plumbers make about thirty-one dollars an hour. Some bill two hundred.

lines.text: BLS median pay, May 2025: plumbers $30.67 an hour, electricians $30.38.
lines.say: Government data puts the May 2025 median at thirty dollars, sixty-seven cents an hour for plumbers, and thirty dollars, thirty-eight cents for electricians.

lines.text: Angi's cost guide: plumbers bill $45 to $200 an hour.
lines.say: Yet Angi's cost guide says plumbers bill anywhere from forty-five to two hundred dollars an hour.

lines.text: Many add a trip fee for the truck, gas and drive time.
lines.say: Many also add a trip fee for the truck, gas and the drive to you.

lines.text: Benefits were 30% of private pay costs (BLS, June 2026). Our math: $30.67 becomes $43.81.
lines.say: Benefits were thirty percent of private employer pay costs in June 2026, so our math turns that wage into about forty-four dollars.

lines.text: Techs can't bill every hour. At 65% billable (an HVAC study), that's $67.40 per billed hour (our math).
lines.say: Techs can't bill every hour. If sixty-five percent are billable, as one study of HVAC techs found, that's about sixty-seven dollars each.

lines.text: Still not counted: truck, insurance, office, profit.
lines.say: That's before the truck, the insurance, the office and any profit.

lines.text: Many shops quote from a flat-rate price book: one set price per job.
lines.say: So many shops quote from a flat-rate price book: one set price per job.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Plumbers make $30.67 an hour. Why bill up to $200?
post.ig:
Plumbers make about $31 an hour. Some bill $200.
BLS median pay, May 2025: plumbers $30.67/hr, electricians $30.38/hr.
Angi's cost guide: plumbers bill $45 to $200 an hour, depending on experience.
Benefits were 30% of private employer pay costs in June 2026 (BLS), so our math turns $30.67 into $43.81.
If 65% of hours are billable (the share one study of HVAC techs found), our math puts the cost at $67.40 per billed hour, before truck, insurance, office and profit.
Sources: BLS OEWS (May 2025), BLS ECEC (June 2026), Angi, Field Promax via ACHR News.
News and education, not financial advice.
